column1: # config/params.example.csv — all the pipeline's values in one file.
# Copy this to s3://<bucket>/config/params.csv (next to config/fleet_tasks.csv) and replace the
# placeholder values with your own. The fleet reads it
# (when no run is in progress) publishes it. tools/setup.sh
# reads the same file at one-time setup.
# Rules:
#   - header must be exactly:  parameter
#   - one row per key; blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored; values are trimmed
#   - a duplicate key or an unknown key is an error
#   - the BUCKET is NOT a key here: it is the bucket this CSV lives in (the fleet's "bucket"
#     input / setup.sh's bucket). That keeps it from disagreeing with where everything is read.
#   - every value that ends up in pipeline.json must be a real value with no '<' or '>'.
#   - dsql_cluster_id is DERIVED (first label of dsql_endpoint) and must NOT be listed here.
parameter
# ---- required (no default) ----
account_id
region
project
dsql_endpoint
# ^ the cluster endpoint from the DSQL console; if Glue has no internet it needs a route to DSQL
#   (e.g. a DSQL VPC endpoint) — the pipeline finds the private hostname itself.
# ---- optional (shown with their defaults; delete a row to accept the default) ----
dsql_user
dsql_database
# glue_connection: exact Glue network connection name
column2: or empty for no VPC (leave value blank).

column1: glue_connection
cdc_engine
cdc_spark_fallback
control_schema
# cdc_validation: Tier-2 CDC validation (re-reads a sample of each committed CDC file and records
#   persistent mismatches in cdc_control.cdc_validation_failures). ON by default; cutover REFUSES
#   to proceed if any unresolved failure exists. Set to false only to disable the check entirely.
cdc_validation
# cdc_validation_sample: rows re-checked per committed CDC file (0 = check every change; costly).
cdc_validation_sample
# max_composite_forks: max composite-PK tables that may be forked out of ONE task. Each composite
# table runs its own always-on CDC job (plus its own load/validate jobs)
# on Glue jobs and DSQL connections per task. Startup fails early (naming the tables) if exceeded.
max_composite_forks
# max_big_cdc_forks: max BIG single/no-PK tables that get their OWN CDC job (bg fork). A big table
# keeps its normal load/validate (shared load-big + validate); only CDC is forked. Overflow beyond
# this cap stays on the MAIN CDC job (serial apply) with a warning — NOT a failure.
max_big_cdc_forks
# ---- planning thresholds (plan_split fan-out knobs; defaults equal the former fixed values) ----
# Changing one of these affects only tasks STARTED AFTER the new pipeline.json is published
# it never re-assigns a table whose CDC job already started (recorded owners win). All are whole
# numbers.
# big_table_row_threshold: a table with >= this many full-load rows is "big" (own load-big group
#   AND its own bg CDC job). Lower it to treat more tables as big; raise it to treat fewer.
big_table_row_threshold
# file_fanout_threshold: a table with >= this many LOAD part-files is also "big" (same effect).
file_fanout_threshold
# big_table_bytes_threshold: a table whose total full-load bytes >= this is also "big" (same
#   effect). This rescues a HUGE SINGLE-FILE table (num_files=1) whose DMS row count is missing
#   from the index
column2: so the biggest table still gets its own load-big group + bg CDC job.

column1: big_table_bytes_threshold
# max_groups: cap on load/validate groups per task (== the pre-created CDC job pool size). Big
#   tables each take one group; small tables bin-pack into the rest.
max_groups
# map_max_concurrency: how many groups/forks load+validate at once (1-40; also the GroupFanOut
#   Map concurrency). Higher = faster but more concurrent Glue runs and DSQL connections.
map_max_concurrency
# max_files_in_parallel: per-loader cap on LOAD files read at once.
max_files_in_parallel
# writers_per_file: concurrent DSQL writer threads for ONE part-file. The DMS full load is often
#   a SINGLE LOAD*.csv per table
column2: so this is the lever that parallelises a big single-file table

column1: #   (default 8). Set to 1 for the old one-writer-per-file behaviour. Bounded by max_write cap.
writers_per_file
# conn_budget: DSQL connection budget shared across in-flight loaders; sets writers-per-loader.
conn_budget
# min_writers_per_loader / max_writers_per_loader: floor/ceiling for a small group's DSQL write
#   concurrency (min <= max).
min_writers_per_loader
max_writers_per_loader
# ---- Glue job sizing (SPEED over cost — size up
column2: don't throttle). Worker TYPES are checked

column1: # against an allow-list {G.1X
# timeouts 1-10080 min (Glue's 7-day max). The load runs DRIVER-SIDE
# (= bigger driver) speeds a big table; worker COUNT mostly helps the CSV read. Defaults put
# load-big + validate on G.8X (128 GB driver)
glue_version
discovery_worker_type
discovery_num_workers
discovery_timeout_minutes
load_worker_type
load_num_workers
load_timeout_minutes
load_big_worker_type
load_big_num_workers
load_big_timeout_minutes
validate_worker_type
validate_num_workers
validate_timeout_minutes
# max_parallel_tables: how many tables load at once on the driver (1-40). per_worker_mem_budget_mb:
#   per-table driver-memory budget the auto-throttle uses (the throttle never drops below a safe
#   floor even if driver memory is unknown/misreported).
max_parallel_tables
per_worker_mem_budget_mb
# glue_role_arn: defaults to arn:aws:iam::<account_id>:role/<project>-glue-exec-role when omitted.
# Only set it if your Glue role name differs from <project>-glue-exec-role.
glue_role_arn
# ---- setup-only: the Glue VPC connection (tools/setup.sh). Set BOTH or NEITHER. ----
# Not part of pipeline.json. Delete both rows if Glue can reach DSQL without a VPC connection.
subnet_id
security_group_id
